posts.name: lynkfox
posts.cooked:
Individually. Each is its own target, and yes, the idealist will get hit with the most damage when Lowest target is applied. In that situation I look to get Writhe's Signature card out, and heal up Idealist above Writhe :)

 

Looking for the card that lets you use another power a turn really helps to get Block going too.

posts.cooked: Semi-related question: what the dickens happens with the Sentinels and the Insula Primalis non-target damage cards?  River of Lava and Primordial Plant Life both say they deal their damage to "each hero", rather than "each hero target".  The Sentinels have four "hero targets", but are collectively just one "hero".  So since the Sentinels virtually never have an Equipment to ditch, does River of Lava always deal 5 damage to each of them, or only to one of them?  We played it the latter way last night, and it seemed more than adequately painful to them as it was.
